overview: Bangkok's temples and family attractions plus the beaches of Phuket or Krabi. Great value, good hotels and lots of Indian restaurants.
fit: Very good for both kids. Choose calm west-coast beaches in season.
season: November to March is dry and pleasant. April is very hot (Songkran water festival mid-April). May–October is the monsoon on the Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi) with rough seas.
gettingAround: Bangkok BTS/MRT and Grab; in Phuket/Krabi, hotel transfers and longtail boats.
